ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Funding in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent developments in Medicaid funding in Minnesota, including the federal investigation and its implications for the state's healthcare system.
questions: What are the implications of the federal investigation for Minnesota's Medicaid funding?
How will the state's healthcare system be affected?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant issues with Medicaid funding in Minnesota, and potentially across the country. I recommend pursuing this story aggressively.

ideas.title: Child Care Fraud: A Growing Concern
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent cases of child care fraud, including the Feeding our Future fraud case, and explore the larger issue of child care fraud in the state and across the country.
questions: What are the common characteristics of child care fraud cases?
How can child care fraud be prevented?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to shed light on a growing concern in the child care industry. I recommend pursuing this story to raise awareness and promote accountability.
